reviewer_role: independent subagent; not an implementation author or WebChat
scope: Pre-execution source review, focused synthetic regressions and frozen source identity checks only

findings.counterexample: Replacing gate-model.json after fit/development but before dispatch formerly caused each new job to accept the replacement SHA as its own reference.
findings.resolution: Exclusive gate-model-freeze binds fitted weights and training-pair bytes. gate_identity verifies the binding before dispatch and after audit; generated deployment, primary audit and fresh reload load the expected SHA. Fit and development receipts bind the same gate. Two regressions reject a replaced valid model or changed fitted identity.

findings.counterexample: fit_seconds previously included export and fresh-process reload although the fit deadline applied only to the solve interval.
findings.resolution: fit_seconds is captured immediately after fitting; export_and_reload_seconds is a separate value.

checked_contracts: Existing validated float64 scorer called once per task callback; canonical input-order score ties match the original first argmax.
Only callback zero of the first eligible turn consumes an assigned window; same-turn suffix and later decisions return to the frozen student. Step-zero episode reset prevents cross-game window reuse.
Gate features use visible time, score gap and two operation identities. Offline targets, Replay seeds and opponent private state do not enter the selector.
One-shot pairs compare canonical initial/prefix states and actual complete requests. An unchanged intervention request requires the entire later trajectory to match.
All eligible zero and negative targets are retained; missing opportunities are retained as missing population cells with no replacement intervention game.
One CPU ridge fit after training signal gates, development pass/fail without tuning, and at most one restricted repeated-use holdout candidate.

Holdout analysis validates the full 64-game panel, resamples all opponents and seats in each of eight complete seed clusters, and recomputes both relative numerator and positive reference denominator.
Live, primary audit, same-state shadow, two original-student parity episodes and at most four independent official-only replay checks fit the declared separate and aggregate budgets.
Registered official run_match filename entry and existing ordered official reexecution are reused. Worker failure stops new dispatch and owned child processes are killed/reaped in finally.

execution_boundary.required_runtime_check: First registered train baseline games include full original JointAgent action parity; every game requires actual filename execution and official ordered replay. Any failure stops the campaign without retry.

limitations: Synthetic regression models and arrays are test fixtures, not training data or a learned research candidate.
Source and registration inspection does not establish realized profit, model admission, teacher parity or empirical compute throughput.
Existing teacher economic opportunities remain a restricted candidate set; this gate does not model the full official legal action space.
Local preregistration is not a third-party prior timestamp. No prior failed research or audit verdict is overridden.
Publication privacy approval and final runtime/data review remain separate gates.
